column1: # 0.0.38 P1: pre-authorised dispositions for queue reds (董秘/政委 10-09).  A red that matches a class
# here is filled into the exit table on the spot; only NEEDS_RULING rows go to a ruling, all at once.
# A disposition never turns a red into PASS and never loosens a limit: it names what happens next.

column2: suite exited 77 (declared host/ISA/tool requirement not met)
column3: record UNVERIFIED with required/observed; coverage obligation stays open; not a release pass

column2: log says a declared tool or its headers were not found
column3: install or point at the tool, re-run only the affected suites in a separate state; keep the original failure

column2: status INTERRUPTED (window killed from outside twice)
column3: diagnose the layer that killed it; never synthesise rc 142 or PASS

column2: rc 142 after the solo retry, suite listed in plans H1
column3: record against the H1 host baseline; limit unchanged
stop the driver and diagnose; do not repeat with 75

column2: suite named in the plan's H1/H2 rows by a ruling (any rc but PASS)
column3: keep the failure on record against that host baseline; fix in the H1/H2 slice; never counted PASS

column2: anything else: wrong output, compile error, sanitizer report, unlisted timeout
column3: one row each in the single ruling request
